signal_definition.lane: post-crash correlation-recovery dynamics (cross-sectional selection, NOT market timing)
signal_definition.construction: per-ticker rolling stock-market corr (20d, 60d) from daily Ret vs BM_Ret; corr20_peak63=trailing 63d max of corr20 (recent panic spike); recovery=peak-corr20; spike=peak-corr60; recovery_frac=recovery/(max(spike,0)+0.05) = fraction of correlation spike already unwound (=de-correlation SPEED). Primary signal corr_recov_resid = cross-sectional residual of recovery_frac on corr20 (abs corr level controlled => NOT low-beta/low-vol).
signal_definition.PIT: all features use daily Ret up to & incl month-end t (sig_date); forward = month t+1 realized return; rolling windows (C1); universe K200|KQ150 membership at t; no concurrent-month use.
signal_definition.hypothesis: fast de-correlation (high recovery_frac) = idiosyncratic/resilient stocks -> excess return (sign to be read from IC).

adversarial_note.sign_instability: RAW recovery_frac and RESID corr_recov carry OPPOSITE full-period IC signs (raw -0.0119 / resid +0.0115). This is a sign-flip under abs-corr-level residualization = unstable mechanism, not a robust edge.
adversarial_note.cherry_pick_trap: The only |t|>=2 result besides raw-full is RESID-2017plus (t=3.54). But its full-period t=1.70 fails the |t|>=2 bar; claiming PASS from the 2017+ subsample alone = subsample-mining. Gate rule (strongest full-period |t| as primary + full AND 2017+ persistence) correctly refuses it.
adversarial_note.raw_decays: RAW passes full-period |t|>=2 and orthogonality but decays to noise post-2017 (t=-0.57), i.e. the KR post-2017 IC->PORT_t transition wall applies to this novel lane too.
adversarial_note.conclusion: No robust, sign-stable, recent-holding cross-sectional signal. Honest STOP before Canonical/PORT_t.
